review_kind: Independent read-only source, bytes, AST and saved synthetic receipts; not a real pilot or release qualification

source_review.conclusion: Cache and diagnostic job flags are strict booleans defaulting false before input I/O. A fresh cache/probe is constructed after ensemble/view/text dispatch, so state is leaf-local. Diagnostics are not enabled by ordinary CLI/default recipes. Source context uses actual history_min_periods and source-role SHA values, not machine paths.

Both diagnostic OFF-cache and ON-cache arms form the same actual CatBoost-prepared fitting X/y objects, ordered rows, fitting weights and explicit fitting scope. Probe, optional cache lookup and actual teacher fit consume these objects. No validation/test target enters teacher digests. The test poisons non-fitting values and checks transformed target, rows, weights and schema sensitivity.

The common typed exact-value teacher key is computed independently in each arm and never supplied to the cache. ON still computes its own original full key on both miss and hit; key disagreement rejects. Component digests distinguish actual inputs from recipe/history/source metadata. Metadata-only equality is not accepted as an eligible hit.

Pure fit starts after prepared argument objects are available and stops immediately after .fit. Constructor, importance extraction, parameter probing, cache hash/store and output copies have distinct fields. Legacy teacher_fit_seconds remains constructor/fit/importance inclusive, so it must not be reported as pure fit. Expensive fitting-frame materialization occurs before the narrow teacher_fit_argument_preparation field and remains charged to whole selector/parent time; per-field timers are not a disjoint partition of parent wall.

Trace exposes pre-decision store eligibility/reason/conservative payload bytes and post-decision resident LRU keys/bytes/counters. Hit records reference a prior same-leaf miss for effective teacher settings; unknown settings are explicitly uncertified. Skipped stores have false/zero invocation telemetry. This supports future exact bounded-LRU replay; the collector itself does not certify or compute pilot mechanism PASS.

Retention is compact metadata/importance, bounded by 64 requests and 4096 columns; unchanged cache is four entries/262144 conservative bytes. No fitting frames, target arrays, weights or fitted models are retained. Sidecar includes ordered requests/source/library/context bindings, and the leaf result binds exact sidecar SHA and I/O cost. Unsupported exact-key/column metadata remains explicit uncacheable/unavailable.

The default path does not construct probes, hash keys or collect get_params. Original teacher/ranking/protected-column behavior remains in place. Mock parity uses a byte-pinned frozen original selector and compares actual fitting arguments plus output frames. Flat map adds both new modules and preserves the worker entry point; the compiled diff contains only the declared four members.
